items.exampleEn: The garden looks nicer after a trim.
items.exampleZh: 修剪過後，花園看起來漂亮多了。

items.exampleEn: Many plants drown if you give them too much water.
items.exampleZh: 很多植物澆太多水會被淹死。

items.exampleEn: Doing the same thing every day can bore anyone.
items.exampleZh: 每天做同樣的事會讓任何人都覺得無聊。

items.exampleEn: With a bang, the old car started.
items.exampleZh: 砰的一聲，那輛舊車發動了。

items.exampleEn: The smoke made us choke and cough.
The castle is illuminated every night for visitors.
items.exampleZh: 這座城堡每晚都會打燈照亮，供遊客觀賞。

items.exampleEn: The boxes tumbled down the stairs.
items.exampleZh: 箱子從樓梯上滾落下來。

items.exampleEn: Be careful not to bump the other car when you park.
items.exampleZh: 停車時小心別撞到另一輛車。

items.sentenceEn: My little brother bumped his knee on the chair.
items.sentenceZh: 我弟弟的膝蓋撞到了椅子。

items.audioEn: I almost fell asleep. The movie bored me, so I left early.
items.audioZh: 我差點睡著。那部電影讓我覺得很無聊，所以我提早離開了。
items.questionZh: 說話者為什麼提早離開？
options: A friend needed help at home.

items.sentenceEn: The door shut with a bang.

items.stemEn: The fireworks ____ the night sky with bright colors.
items.stemZh: 煙火用明亮的色彩照亮了夜空。

items.stemEn: Cut the meat into small pieces so the baby won't ____.
items.stemZh: 把肉切成小塊，寶寶才不會噎到。

items.passageEn: Last summer, our family went camping by a lake. On the first evening, my dad gave my little brother a quick trim because his hair was too long. My sister said the long drive had bored her, but she cheered up when we lit the fire. The fire illuminated our faces. Suddenly, we heard a loud bang: a pot had fallen off the table. My brother laughed so hard that he almost choked on his juice. Later, as we walked back from the lake in the dark, I bumped into a tree and tumbled onto the grass. My dad reminded us never to swim at night, because people can drown. The next morning was glorious and sunny.
items.passageZh: 去年夏天，我們全家去湖邊露營。第一天傍晚，爸爸幫我弟弟稍微修剪了頭髮，因為他的頭髮太長了。我姊姊說長途車程讓她很無聊，但我們生起營火後，她就開心起來了。火光照亮了我們的臉。突然，我們聽到砰的一聲巨響：一個鍋子從桌上掉了下來。弟弟笑得太厲害，差點被果汁嗆到。後來，我們在黑暗中從湖邊走回來時，我撞到一棵樹，滾倒在草地上。爸爸提醒我們晚上絕對不要游泳，因為可能會溺水。第二天早上陽光燦爛，天氣美好極了。

questions.questionZh: 突然的巨響是怎麼來的？
options: 一個鍋子從桌上掉下來
一棵大樹被風吹倒壓到了帳篷
火要等完全熄滅才能離開

referenceEn: I bumped into my teacher at the door.
I bumped into the teacher at the door.
rubricZh: bump 表示「撞、碰」，例如 bump into… 等說法

items.instructionZh: 用 bore 造一個句子，說說什麼事情會讓你覺得無聊。
referenceEn: Waiting in line always bores me.
Math class sometimes bores me, but I still listen.
rubricZh: bore 表示「使厭煩、使無聊」，例如 … bores me 等說法
說的是自己的感受（例如 me）
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式；說過去的事用過去式等）
